description.v: Profile to use in mvn command to run the tests. Possible values are wls-srg (the default), integration-tests, toolkits-srg, kind-sequential and kind-upgrade. Refer to weblogic-kubernetes-operator/integration-tests/pom.xml on the branch.
Comma separated list of individual It test classes to be run e.g., ItParameterizedDomain, ItMiiUpdateDomainConfig, ItMiiDynamicUpdate*, ItMiiMultiMode
The default log level is not set
Kind version.
Helm version
Istio version
Runs tests in parallel. Default is true, test classes run in parallel.
Number of threads to run the classes in parallel, default is 3.
URL to download WDT.
URL to download WIT.
RemoteConsole version.
Repository to pull the base images. Make sure to modify the image names if you are modifying this parameter value.
WebLogic base image name. Default is the image name in BASE_IMAGES_REPO. Use middleware/weblogic for OCR.

14.1.2.0-generic-jdk17-ol8, 14.1.2.0-generic-jdk17-ol9, 14.1.2.0-generic-jdk21-ol8, 14.1.2.0-generic-jdk21-ol9, 12.2.1.4-generic-jdk8-ol7, 12.2.1.4-generic-jdk8-ol8, 12.2.1.4-generic-jdk8-ol9, 12.2.1.4-slim-jdk8-ol7,12.2.1.4-slim-jdk8-ol7, 12.2.1.4-slim-jdk8-ol7, 14.1.1.0-generic-jdk8-ol7, 14.1.1.0-generic-jdk8-ol8, 14.1.1.0-generic-jdk8-ol9, 14.1.1.0-generic-jdk11-ol8, 14.1.1.0-generic-jdk11-ol9, 14.1.1.0-slim-jdk11-ol7, 14.1.1.0-slim-jdk11-ol8, 14.1.1.0-slim-jdk8-ol7, 14.1.1.0-slim-jdk8-ol8
FWM Infra image name. Default is the image name in BASE_IMAGES_REPO. Use middleware/fmw-infrastructure for OCR.
Oracle DB image name. Default is the image name in BASE_IMAGES_REPO, use database/enterprise for OCR.
Oracle DB image tag
Collect logs for successful runs. Default is false.

                            echo "-Dwko.it.istio.version="${ISTIO_VERSION}""                                           >> ${WORKSPACE}/.mvn/maven.config

                                    echo "Failed to run journalctl for kind worker"
                                fi
                                if ! podman exec kind-control-plane journalctl --utc --dmesg --system > "${result_root}/journalctl-kind-control-plane.out"; then
                                    echo "Failed to run journalctl for kind control plane"
                                fi
                                if ! journalctl --utc --dmesg --system --since "$start_time" > "${result_root}/journalctl-compute.out"; then
                                    echo "Failed to run journalctl for compute node"
                                fi

export PATH="${WORKSPACE}/bin:${PATH}"
